title: Impact of Analyst Buy Recommendations on Stock Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

We will use a Difference-in-Differences (DID) approach to estimate the causal impact of analyst buy recommendations on stock returns. The DID method is suitable here because we have a treatment group (stocks receiving buy recommendations) and a control group (stocks not receiving buy recommendations), and we can compare the difference in returns before and after the event.

The key assumption in DID is that the treatment and control groups would have followed the same trend in the absence of the treatment. In this case, we assume that the returns of stocks receiving buy recommendations would have followed the same trend as those not receiving recommendations if the recommendations had not been made.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(plm)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s58_data.csv")

# Create a binary variable for event day (1 if event day, 0 otherwise)
data$event <- ifelse(data$event_day == 0, 1, 0)

# Create a panel data structure
pdata <- pdata.frame(data, index = c("stock_id", "event_day"))

# Run the DID regression
model <- plm(ret ~ event + mkt_ret + beta, data = pdata, model = "within")

# Print the coefficient for the event variable
summary(model)$coefficients["event", "Estimate"]

# Robustness check: Clustered standard errors
coeftest(model, vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))
```

## 3. Expected Findings

We expect the coefficient on the event variable to be negative, indicating that analyst buy recommendations lead to a decline in stock returns. The magnitude of the effect will depend on the data, but we expect it to be statistically significant given the large sample size. This is because buy recommendations may signal overvaluation or negative information about the stock, leading to a decline in its price.

_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The analysis suggests a negative impact of analyst buy recommendations on 1-day CAR.
